**Finding: compliant (sits at the fallback).**

The licence analogue in this consortium agreement is the capacity/IRU regime in Paragraph 12, read with the assignment provisions in Paragraph 22 and Paragraph 30:

- **Affiliates on written notice** — 12.8 lets a Party use its WAC to provide services with its Affiliate and its Parent Company's Affiliate; 12.14 allows Transfer of Allocated Capacity to those Affiliates; 22.3(c)–(d) allow assignment of the whole to a Subsidiary or Affiliate "at any time", outside the 22.2 consent gate, subject only to timely written notice under 22.6.
- **Successor transfer** — 22.3(a) permits assignment of the whole to "a successor of that Party" on notice only, and Paragraph 30 binds successors and permitted assigns.
- **Not revocable at will** — Allocated Capacity is held on an ownership basis (12.2), IRU is defined as an "Indefeasible Right of Use", and reclamation arises only on uncured payment default (23.1–23.2). Far from walk-away territory.

Noted in the rationale rather than redlined (preferred-only or minor mechanics): contractors acting on our behalf are not named in the grant; affiliate use/Transfer carries a Carrier qualification and an Annex 7 cash contribution until the 12.15 relaxation; and 12.23 defers IRU guidelines and IRU agreement terms to the I&ASC, though no IRU agreement may override this Agreement. Worth monitoring those guidelines so they do not narrow affiliate or contractor use.
